categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Adds tracepoints in src/net_processing.cpp and blockencodings helper structs to observe header and compact block reconstruction events.
categories.rationale: Adds USDT observability for block header arrivals and compact block reconstruction to avoid reliance on string-based debug logs. Reviewers noted value in exposing compact block data in a non-logging way for relay performance measurement, but this is non-critical diagnostic instrumentation that is reasonably deferrable.
